customer_jenny: Hey support — our service started getting 400s from the embeddings/rerank endpoint after we switched to batching. Example request_id: rq_01GX9QKZ7. Error in response: "embedding dimension mismatch". Can you help repro?

sara_support: Thanks @customer_jenny — sorry about that. Can you paste the exact curl you used and the payload shape (how you batch)? Also confirm which model you were calling (model name/version).

customer_jenny: Curl we used (sanitized):

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"open-embedding-1024","query_embedding":[0.1,0.2,...,0.3],"candidate_embeddings":[[0.2,0.1,...,0.5],[0.3,0.4,...,0.6]]}'
```

Our embeddings are 768 dims (from upstream encoder), we thought rerank accepts arbitrary dims if model supports smaller dims? The response body:
